name: safe-drain
description: A behavioral policy for long-running, quota-sensitive agent tasks: use native runtime usage information, adapt cadence and work size, and checkpoint before projected drain.

interface.longDescription: SafeDrain is a small behavioral skill for long-running or quota-sensitive Codex and agent tasks. It teaches the active agent to query native runtime usage information proactively, evaluate each quota window against user-supplied session thresholds, adapt both usage-check cadence and work-unit size as pressure rises, and checkpoint before starting work projected to reach drain. Native Capability First: SafeDrain supplies instructions, not quota telemetry or a background monitor. It requires an agent-queryable native usage capability and an existing project recovery mechanism. Naturalistic validation supports the documented behavior; it does not establish universal reliability or the ability to interrupt an operation that never returns control.
capabilities: Adapt work cadence and unit size
defaultPrompt: Use SafeDrain for a long code review; ask for my quota thresholds and checkpoint before projected drain.
Use SafeDrain for a multi-step bug fix with my session thresholds; adapt work size and native usage checks.
Use SafeDrain to plan a costly asset-generation task; collect my thresholds and preflight each expensive operation.
